name: Zhejiang Taimei Medical Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Taimei Medical Technology Co., Ltd. was established in 2013 and has its base in Jiaxing, China. It provides digital operational platforms for the biopharmaceutical industry in China. Its core product is TrialOS, a digital collaboration platform that links participants across the drug development and research process, including hospitals and pharmaceutical companies.
